prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Tyler TX?
answer_verbatim:
I don’t have live access to current local business listings, so I can’t tell you a single “best” salon in Tyler right now. “Best” also depends on what you want (spray tan vs UV beds, budget, membership, boutique vs chain). If you tell me which type you prefer I can give more tailored advice. Meanwhile, here’s a quick, practical way to find the best salon for you and what to check when you visit:

How to find candidates
- Search Google Maps, Yelp, Facebook, and Nextdoor for “tanning salon Tyler TX” and sort by rating and recent reviews.
- Look for salons with lots of recent positive reviews (photos from customers are a good sign).
- Ask friends or local community groups for personal recommendations.

What to check before booking
- Type of tanning: spray tans (airbrush/booth) vs UV tanning beds — pick the one you want.
- Cleanliness and hygiene: booths/beds and lounges should be clean; techs should use gloves/wash hands.
- Staff training and certifications: especially for spray tans (certified technicians reduce streaking/uneven color).
- Products used: ask what spray solution they use (DHA percentage, bronzers, hypoallergenic/organic options).
- Bed equipment and maintenance: modern high-pressure beds give faster, more even results; inquire how often bulbs are changed.
- Patch test and skin consultation: reputable salons do a brief skin-type consult and offer/test solutions.
- Price/packages and membership deals: compare per-session cost vs packages.
- Before/after photos: ask to see real client photos for your skin tone.
- Safety policies: look for guidance on recommended exposure, protective eyewear, and contraindications.

What to ask on the phone or in person
- “Do you recommend spray or UV for my skin type?”
- “What solution/brand do you use for spray tans?”
- “How often are bed bulbs replaced/serviced?”
- “Can I see recent client photos for someone with my skin tone?”
- “Do you offer a patch test and what is your refund/rescheduling policy?”

If you want, tell me:
- Spray tan or UV beds?
- Your location or neighborhood in Tyler
and I’ll give a short checklist of likely salons to call or what to look for in the top results. If you paste a few salon names or links you found, I can help compare them.
